data.rootCause: The render has a strong opening and good food beauty, but it collapses on execution discipline: the middle repeats the same chef/plating idea too long, the typography never appears as a coherent multi-beat system, the audio/SFX design is under-delivered versus the plan, and the end has a generic craving close without a clear brand identity or instantly legible visit-tonight CTA. Also, the actual footage includes off-brief/irrelevant hero beats (notably the eating woman) that interrupt the premium sushi story instead of escalating it.

issues.problem: The edit lingers too long in near-identical chef/prep coverage, causing the middle to feel repetitive instead of escalating.
issues.fix: Cut the repeated preparation beats and compress the middle into one freshness beat, one precision beat, and one premium reveal.

issues.problem: Brand identity is weak; the reel does not clearly establish KAIRO Sushi in a memorable way until very late, and even then it feels generic.
issues.fix: Introduce KAIRO branding earlier and end with a single unmistakable brand lock-up on the cleanest hero frame.

issues.problem: The woman-eating footage is off-tone and interrupts the sushi craft story; it feels like an unrelated stock-style reaction shot rather than premium restaurant storytelling.
issues.fix: Remove or minimize the reaction shot unless it is used only as the final payoff before the CTA.

issues.problem: The render does not feel like a finished commercial audio mix; the planned SFX and polish are not clearly present in the actual cut.
issues.fix: Add visible torch/slice/bite SFX accents and a more intentional music swell with a clean CTA hit.

issues.problem: Typography is not executed as a coherent, premium system across the reel; text appears inconsistent and underused relative to the plan.
issues.fix: Use fewer, larger, more deliberate text beats with strong safe-area placement and clear hierarchy.

issues.problem: The edit repeats the same chef-and-roll visual language across too many beats, reducing freshness of cuts.
issues.fix: Alternate angle, scale, and subject matter more aggressively; move from close prep to overhead reveal to human bite faster.
